component {

    function run() {
        var x = [
            1,
            2,
            3,
        ];
        var s = {
            a: 1,
            b: 2,
            c: 3,
        };
        [
            a,
            ,
            c,
        ] = x;
        [
            ,
            b,
            c,
        ] = x;
        [
            a,
            b,
            ,
        ] = x;
        [
            a,
            ...r
        ] = x;
        ({
            a,
            b: bb,
            ...rest
        } = s);
        ({
            a,
            b,
        } = s);
        var [
            p,
            q,
        ] = x;
        writeOutput(a & b & c & bb & p & q & arrayLen(r) & structCount(rest));
    }

}
~

component {

    function run() {
        var x = [
              1
            , 2
            , 3
        ];
        var s = {
              a: 1
            , b: 2
            , c: 3
        };
        [
              a
            ,
            , c
        ] = x;
        [
            , b
            , c
        ] = x;
        [
              a
            , b
            , ,
        ] = x;
        [
              a
            , ...r
        ] = x;
        ({
              a
            , b: bb
            , ...rest
        } = s);
        ({
              a
            , b
        } = s);
        var [
              p
            , q
        ] = x;
        writeOutput(a & b & c & bb & p & q & arrayLen(r) & structCount(rest));
    }

}
~
component {

    function run() {
        var x = [
             1
            ,2
            ,3
        ];
        var s = {
             a: 1
            ,b: 2
            ,c: 3
        };
        [
             a
            ,
            ,c
        ] = x;
        [
            ,b
            ,c
        ] = x;
        [
             a
            ,b
            ,,
        ] = x;
        [
             a
            ,...r
        ] = x;
        ({
             a
            ,b: bb
            ,...rest
        } = s);
        ({
             a
            ,b
        } = s);
        var [
             p
            ,q
        ] = x;
        writeOutput(a & b & c & bb & p & q & arrayLen(r) & structCount(rest));
    }

}
